title: Tōhoku 2011 megathrust — preset replay reference
description: Reference replay of the EARTHQUAKE_PRESETS.TOHOKU_2011 input. Pins the Tier-2 NOAA validation envelope (Mw 9.1, mean slip 10.5-15.5 m, MMI VII reach > 50 km) — see B-006 in BUG_REGISTRY.md.

tsunami.meanSlip.m.comment: M0 / (mu * L * W) on the Strasser 2010 regressions the rest of the result is drawn with, 702 x 205 km. The inversions average about 10 m over a larger assumed area; this used to read 8.5 because the tsunami module derived a second width of its own as L / 2.5, which made the slip look right and the wave wrong.

tsunami.amplitudeAt1000kmDispersed.m.comment: Kajiura dispersion on the field's spreading law: from half the down-dip width, with the energy normalisation of a ring. 0.69 m here, where the old law read 2.36 and at DART 21413 read 1.93 m against the 0.30 recorded.
